Liaise with CO’s Supply Chain Unit to guide on proper provision of ICT-related equipment, supplies, services, and propose the most suitable solutions. In coordination with the ICT Information Security Unit at HQ, act as the Focal Point, the first line of cybersecurity defense, and first local cybersecurity incident responder in the CO.
